page.layout: Top of page: one centred title block (two lines, the second spaced capitals). Below it four parallel columns of index entries: column 1 (left, alphabetical A to R, running on to the bottom of this part), column 2 (Ranunculus onward, with a number at its head), column 3 (Hebrew and Arabic entries), column 4 (Hebrew and Latin entries, with a small Perse heading). No margin notes. The page is cut off at the lower right and in the lower middle; only this part is transcribed.; One printed page, single column of index lines at top, then a section headed INDEX NOMINVM Hebraicorum with running text in a narrow column, then a list of Hebrew and Arabic entries with page numbers. Margin notes: none.; One printed page, a two-column index of Hebrew and Arabic words with page references, in the right-hand column of the scan; the text continues below in the same column. Top: a line of running catchwords in the margin.; Lower part of the page: a right-hand column of Greek index entries continuing from above, with a Hebrew-letter column and small entries at the lower left; below the right column a page number "3" with an asterisk. Lower area of text in three columns (left, middle, right), read left to right, then the page number.
